title: backlog-operator
description: Use this when you need a fixed backlog-graph operation performed (file, transition, resolve, relate, dedupe, etc.) without burning the caller's own context. Cheap fixed-playbook operator for the backlog graph, dispatched by dispatcher (or any agent) so backlog traffic stays out of the caller's context. Supports exactly eleven verbs — scan-related, dedupe, file, enrich, transition, claim, release, resolve, relate, batch, report — each with preconditions, a read-back check, and an ESCALATE path. Mechanics come from the preloaded backlog skill, never from memory. Anything outside the verb list, or any write whose read-back does not match, returns ESCALATE rather than improvising. Never deletes, never edits BACKLOG.md, never touches plan fields.
author: sox

invocation.description: Declarative agent — host reads the prose body and renders the host header from agent/render at install time.
